title: Three Nights and One Short Score
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：violin　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 violin 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the musician ① played the violin that no listener in the hall would have measured, and he said the playing was the whole of the night. The ② violin, meaning the instrument itself and not the score, ran three nights and stayed unmeasured in the book; a violin, he said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ violin in that hall had the same short score beside it, and the ④ violin at the far piano, meaning the note they kept for the children to play and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A violin, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the musician said the measuring is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the violin was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the instrument. The ⑥ violin, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; violin, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both an instrument and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ violin had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short score. The ⑧ violin of the whole thing, the musician wrote in December, was one hall and three nights of measuring; violin, he said, is either the note at the far piano or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ violin I remember is the instrument measured in the programme, which closed in 1980 and is still measured as the quietest in the hall. A ⑩ violin, my mother said in 1982, is the only instrument that improves by being measured; every violin, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like an instrument. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小提琴（指音乐厅里每一把旁边的那一把）
B. n. 小提琴（指那把小提琴本身，与薄薄的乐谱相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the violin 拉这一把小提琴
D. n. 小提琴（指留给孩子们弹的那一个）
E. n. 小提琴之事（抽象总称，指一处音乐厅的小提琴之事）
F. n. 小提琴（指节目单里写到、被测量的那一把）
G. n. 小提琴、心声（指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心声（抽象总称，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the violin that no listener in the hall would have measured
The violin, meaning the instrument itself and not the score
the violin at the far piano
the violin was the whole of the matter
the violin had become a line in a programme
The violin of the whole thing
A violin, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: play the violin 意为“拉这一把小提琴”，1973 年那位乐师把音乐厅里没有一位听客肯测量的一把小提琴做了一遍。
violin 意为“小提琴”，指那把小提琴本身而不是薄薄的乐谱，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。
violin 意为“小提琴”，指音乐厅里每一把旁边的那一把，每一把旁边都有同一份薄薄的乐谱。
violin 意为“小提琴”，指最远那张琴凳的留给孩子们弹的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
violin 意为“小提琴、心声”，指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这把心声就是那件事的全部。
violin 意为“心声”，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西而不是那把小提琴，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
violin 意为“小提琴”，指节目单里写到、被测量的那一把，到 1978 年这一把成了节目单里的一行。
violin 意为“小提琴之事”，乐师十二月写道，整件事的小提琴之事是一处音乐厅和三个夜晚的测量。
violin 意为“小提琴”，我记得的是节目单里测量过的那一把，1980 年奏完了，至今仍被说成音乐厅里最安静的一把。
violin 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，小提琴是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的小提琴。

那把小提琴，指的是那把小提琴本身而不是薄薄的乐谱，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。（violin）
那处音乐厅里每一把小提琴旁边都有同一份薄薄的乐谱。（violin）
